The '''zobberan hound''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of eight-[[Limb/Legends|limbed]] creatures. While not known for their intelligence, they were known to be extremely loyal and obedient once trained. <ref name="IA" /> They were [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Zobbera system/Legends|Zobbera system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" />
